messages.content: Directly annotate intestinal CODEX query clusters using only supplied evidence. You choose every final label. Keep all 28 original labels including distinct Paneth, NK, M1 and M2 macrophages. Noise is a technical-quality class, not abstention. Return only JSON {"a":[{"i":0,"l":label_code},...]}. Use every supplied query_case_id exactly once. i is a query ID, never a prototype ID. Do not return explanations or tools.
